script.title: PICKING UP A PRESCRIPTION
script.story_hook: Picking up a prescription at the pharmacy.
script.intro_zh: 在藥局領取處方藥並問清楚用法。
script.welcome_en: Hi everyone, glad you're here! Today we're at the pharmacy.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨大家好，很高興你們來！今天我們來到藥局。
script.outro: That's all for today! Keep practicing and see you next time.
script.outro_zh: 今天就到這裡！繼續練習，下次見。
script.practice_intro_en: Now listen and repeat each sentence after me.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在跟著我，一句一句聆聽並跟讀。
script.char_a_description: a tired-looking man in his early thirties with short dark brown hair and glasses, wearing a navy zip hoodie and gray joggers, rubbing the back of his neck
script.char_b_description: a warm pharmacist in her fifties with a silver bob haircut, wearing a white lab coat over a teal blouse, holding a paper bag and reading glasses on a chain
script.youtube_title: 【💊藥局取藥🧾】「這個到底怎麼吃？」超實用處方籤英文🩺聽完就會問｜Picking Up a Prescription
script.youtube_title_en: “How Exactly Should I Take It?” — Picking Up a Prescription
script.youtube_description:
在藥局領藥，卻不好意思問用法？這段超真實的藥局對話，幫你一次學好！跟著病人從報姓名、出示身分證、確認續藥次數，到「要配飯吃嗎」的完整問法。整段 18 句美式日常英語，附繁體中文翻譯與 IPA 標音，後半段逐句跟讀，聽一遍就敢開口問。
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱我們的頻道，每天一集，讓英語變成你的直覺！
script.youtube_description_en:
Too shy to ask how to take your medicine at the pharmacy? This super-realistic pharmacy chat fixes that in one listen. Follow the patient through giving his name, showing ID, checking refills, and asking how to take it with food — 18 lines of everyday American English with IPA. Repeat every line in the second half and speak up today.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】💊處方取藥英文｜報出生日・確認續藥・服用方式｜聽完就會問｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
領藥時聽不懂用法，卻又不敢再問？
續藥次數、要不要配飯吃，用英文怎麼說？

這一集帶大家走進一家藥局，跟著病人從報姓名、出示身分證，到確認續藥次數與服用方式，全程都用自然的美式英語。

你會聽到：
🧾 報資料領藥：例如「here to pick up a prescription」、「what's your name and birth date」。
🔁 確認續藥：例如「How many refills do I have left?」、「good through next August」。
💊 問服用方式：例如「How exactly should I take it?」、「always with some food」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

看完記得實戰一次，原來藥局取藥可以這麼簡單！
script.title_quote: how exactly should I take it

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I'm here to pick up a prescription.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪm hɪr tu pɪk ʌp ə prɪˈskrɪpʃən/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我來領取我的處方藥。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, what's your name and birth date?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr wɑts jɔr neɪm ənd bɜrθ deɪt/
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，你的名字和出生日期是？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Daniel Reyes, born March twelfth, ninety-two.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdæniəl ˈreɪez bɔrn mɑrtʃ twɛlfθ ˈnɪnti tu/
dialogue.zh: Daniel Reyes，出生於九二年三月十二日。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks. Do you have your ID with you?
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks du ju hæv jɔr aɪdi wɪð ju/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。你有帶身份證件嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, here's my license, sorry for rushing.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs hɪrz maɪ ˈlaɪsəns ˈsɑri fɔr ˈrʌʃɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 有的，這是我駕照，抱歉趕了一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No worries. This is your blood-pressure pill.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈwɜriz ðɪs ɪz jɔr blʌd ˈprɛʃər pɪl/
dialogue.zh: 別擔心。這是你的降血壓藥。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great. How many refills do I have left?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt haʊ ˈmɛni ˈrɪfɪlz du aɪ hæv lɛft/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。我還有幾次續藥額度？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three refills, good through next August.
dialogue.zh: 三次續藥，有效到明年八月。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. How exactly should I take it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt haʊ ɪɡˈzæktli ʃʊd aɪ teɪk ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 完美。我到底該怎麼服用？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One each morning, always with some food.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn itʃ ˈmɔrnɪŋ ˈɔlweɪz wɪð sʌm fud/
dialogue.zh: 每天早上一次，一定要配點食物。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: With food, got it. Any side effects?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪð fud ɡɑt ɪt ˈɛni saɪd ɪˈfɛkts/
dialogue.zh: 配食物，明白了。有什麼副作用嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Might feel dizzy at first, that's normal.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪt fil ˈdɪzi æt fɜrst ðæts ˈnɔrməl/
dialogue.zh: 起初可能會頭暈，那很正常。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay. Should I skip it if I feel fine?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ʃʊd aɪ skɪp ɪt ɪf aɪ fil faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 好。如果我覺得沒事，能停藥嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, keep taking it daily, even when fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ kip ˈteɪkɪŋ ɪt ˈdeɪli ˈivən wɛn faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 不行，要每天持續吃，就算沒事也吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Understood. Do I owe you for this today?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌʌndərˈstʊd du aɪ oʊ ju fɔr ðɪs təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 了解。這筆我今天還要付錢嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your insurance covered it, so it's free.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr ɪnˈʃʊrəns ˈkʌvərd ɪt soʊ ɪts fri/
dialogue.zh: 你的保險涵蓋了，所以免費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wonderful, thank you for explaining all that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwʌndərfəl θæŋk ju fɔr ɪkˈspleɪnɪŋ ɔl ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，謝謝你解釋得這麼清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're welcome! See you next month, Daniel.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr ˈwɛlkəm si ju nɛkst mʌnθ ˈdæniəl/
